evidence.quote: match restored.Problems with | problem :: _ -> failed (Diagnostics.describe problem)

ARC-REV-01.rationale: The new rules are all in Tier 2. Transfer.read does the validation and the data-version check, in Summa.Storage. The engine decides when an import is allowed (only into empty books, not on GitHub, and only with the files pack) and what the notice says. The Tier 3 wire only maps three event names to messages and decides nothing. Both Storage and Engine are Tier 2, so the engine can use Transfer.

ARC-REV-02.rationale: Transfer.export and Transfer.read are pure and are documented as such. The engine takes the time from ctx.Now (line 190), not from the clock. The download is requested as data with OfferDownload(...), and persistence goes through the existing save, which emits SaveBooks. Neither the diff nor the tests add a clock, I/O or console use below Tier 4, and the composition root and wire are unchanged.

ARC-REV-03.rationale: The schema name and version are single literals in Transfer.fs (Schema, Version). The classification comes from Exports.Classification and the data version from Exports.dataVersion, so both are reused. The snapshot format comes from LocalSnapshot.encode and decode. The timestamp format is private to Transfer.fs. The 'yyyy-MM-dd' day format appears twice in the engine handlers, but it is a presentation format and the copies agree. No fact has two competing definitions.

evidence.quote: | Some(a, b, d) when a <> int64 contents.Customers || b <> int64 contents.Invoices || d <> int64 contents.Payments -> Error "The books in this file do not match its contents."

ARC-REV-01.rationale: The counting and the contents-mismatch check are in Transfer (Tier 2). The preview is projected in Summa.Web.Engine (Tier 2) from Transfer.read's result. The wire and the HTML only bind the view value 'booksTransferPreview' (data-text) and add no logic. Tier 3 does not re-derive any counts or rules.

ARC-REV-02.rationale: The change adds no effect. The preview is a pure function of the pasted text, computed in the view projection. contentsOf is pure, and Transfer.read stays pure. Time still comes from ctx.Now, and nothing was added below Tier 4.

evidence.quote: | Error why -> $"This file cannot be imported: {why}"
when version <> 1L && version <> int64 Version -> Error $"Transfer files of version {version} cannot be read here."

ARC-REV-03.rationale: Counting has one definition: contentsOf serves both export and read, and the preview uses the Transferred.Contents field. Two things are restated, and in both cases the copies agree. First, the sentence prefix 'This file cannot be imported: ' is now written both in the BooksTransferImported handler (added in change set 1) and in transferPreview, so the two can drift. Second, the set of readable versions is split between the literal 1L and Version = 2. The 'yyyy-MM-dd' day format is also repeated.
